definitions.explanation: A small, typically ceramic cup used for drinking sake. Usually holds about 30-50 ml. A staple item at izakaya and traditional Japanese restaurants.

examples.japanese: お{猪口|ちょこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: To drink sake from an ochoko cup.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧お{猪口|ちょこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有田焼|ありたやき}→有田焼：28604_aritayaki⟧です。
examples.english: This sake cup is Arita ware.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧お{猪口|ちょこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧⟦{杯|はい}→杯：00933_hai⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧だった。
examples.english: My grandfather's habit was to drink just two small cups of sake every evening.

notes:
The お is an honorific prefix and is almost always included — {猪口|ちょこ} alone is rarely used.

SAKE DRINKING VESSELS:
- お{猪口|ちょこ}: small cup (30-50 ml), the most common
- ⟦{盃|さかずき}→盃：13677_sakazuki⟧: flat, saucer-shaped cup (used in ceremonies)
- {枡|ます}: square wooden box (sometimes used for sake)
- ⟦{徳利|とっくり}→徳利：19495_tokkuri⟧: sake carafe/flask (pours into お{猪口|ちょこ})

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{猪口|ちょこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink from an ochoko
- お{猪口|ちょこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注|つ}ぐ→注ぐ：02470_tsugu⟧: to pour into an ochoko
- お{猪口|ちょこ}⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧: one cup (of sake)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Ceramic お{猪口|ちょこ} in various regional styles are popular souvenir items. Many izakaya let customers choose their preferred cup.
